FN-G3WP366-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 105
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Keith Kelley
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 01/16/2026
Senate Bill 105 as introduced would require counties and municipalities to annually publish
certain financial information on official county and municipal websites, or certain other
websites if an official county or municipal website is not maintained. This could increase the
administrative obligations of the counties and municipalities not currently providing financial
information through online publication.
Page 1

FN-G3WP366-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 105
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Keith Kelley
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 01/20/2026
Senate Bill 105 as reported by the Committee on County and Municipal Government would
require counties and municipalities to annually publish certain fiscal information on official
county and municipal websites, or certain other websites if an official county or municipal
website is not maintained. This could increase the administrative obligations of the counties and
municipalities not currently providing financial information through online publication.
This bill would increase the administrative obligations of the Chief Examiner of the Department
of Examiners of Public Accounts to adopt rules pursuant to the provision of this bill.
Page 1

FN-G3WP366-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 105
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Keith Kelley
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 03/17/2026
Senate Bill 105 as passed the Senate could increase the administrative obligations of any
counties and municipalities that do not currently annually publish certain financial information
on the official county or municipal websites, or certain other websites, if an official county or
municipal website is not maintained.
This bill would also increase the administrative obligations of the Chief Examiner of the
Department of Examiners of Public Accounts to adopt rules pursuant to the provision of this
bill.
